speaker: rep
text: Good morning Tom, can you hear me clearly?

speaker: prospect
text: Loud and clear. I have about twenty minutes.

speaker: rep
text: Perfect. What made you take this meeting?

speaker: prospect
text: We hired eight new reps and ramping them is taking forever.

speaker: prospect
text: Right now everything lives in HubSpot and our sequences run through Outreach.

speaker: rep
text: How do you coach the new hires on live calls?

speaker: prospect
text: We built a little internal tool that flags keywords, so I am not sure we need another system.

speaker: rep
text: Fair enough. What does that tool miss?

speaker: prospect
text: It only works after the call, so it never helps in the moment.

speaker: prospect
text: Is the pricing per seat, and is there a free trial?

speaker: rep
text: Per seat, and we can do a two week trial.

speaker: prospect
text: The last quote we got for something like this was way too expensive.

speaker: prospect
text: Also procurement has to review every new vendor, which takes a while.

speaker: rep
text: I can send our security documents now so procurement can get started.

speaker: prospect
text: That works. Let's set up the trial for three reps on Monday.
